closed.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: closed assembled Red Bird Sundial Box landmark vessel for 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule, id red-bird.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
Image 1 is style-sheet A, the required STYLE reference: match its clean hand-inked object art exactly. Image 2 is HKUST's official photo sundial_M0089_01_m001R2.jpg, the Red Bird sundial in the Entrance Piazza; use only its characteristic swept red curves as landmark inspiration, not its exact sculpture geometry. Image 3 confirms that same sculpture in the Piazza against the curved academic building. Do not draw the buildings or photograph in the art.
Create an ORIGINAL souvenir keepsake, not a replica, logo or official merchandise: one low ROUND BRASS BOX, fully CLOSED, whose lid is a sundial dial. Front three-quarter view, softly lit upper left. Round lid seen as an ellipse, brass body with a narrow darker front seam and a simple rolled brass rim. A few short radial hour tick marks on the lid, NO numerals, letters or symbols. A subtle small hinge at the rear midpoint connects the lid to the body. No front clasp, catch, keyhole or knob.
The sundial pointer is a bold simplified wax-red sculptural bird shape: one tall broad upward-swept tapering curved blade, accompanied at its foot by two short crescent-like upward-curving wings. Red Bird landmark silhouette, NOT a natural bird with a head, beak, feathers or eyes. A small compact wax-red curved form fixed securely to the lid. Take inspiration from the three sweeping curved planes in Image2 while simplifying and changing their proportions; do not trace the photograph or use a university logo. Use wax red #A3364F with lighter muted red highlights and a darker plum shadow tone; brass #C9A15A box. No orange plastic, neon red or chrome. The soft cast shadow from the pointer lies across the dial to the lower right; small, soft and no outline. No ground shadow outside the object.
Composition constraints: square transparent RGBA canvas, all corners clear. Entire vessel centered horizontally. Total visible width about68% of canvas and never above74%. Bottom of brass base at88% canvas height (y900 on1024); tallest red tip around y200. Low brass body approx y680–900, dial approx y600–770, red shape rises from around y665 to y220. Keep generous empty space above and on all sides. The box is squat, wide and round, NOT a trophy, pedestal, ring box or tall cylinder. Clearly legible brass rim and bold red pointer at40px and120px. Light sparse hatching only on brass, no busy engraving.
Lid entirely CLOSED flush to body. No visible letter, interior, open lid, extra loose pieces, text, logos, HKUST emblem, branding, scenery, ground plane or watermark.
